tip.en: Heart rate hit your session maximum of 170 bpm at just 1.5 km — on a flat course at a 6:19 pace. Your recent 10-km avg HR is 148; getting there in under 10 minutes suggests you pushed the opening kilometre far too hard for a 10-km prep run.
tip.zh: 在平坦路面、配速6:19的情况下，不到1.5公里心率就飙升至170。备赛长距离时，前段心率过激会透支后程储备，建议前2公里保持心率在155以下。

tip.en: Pace collapsed to 41+ min/km for about 40 seconds at km 2 and HR dropped from 162 to 134 — a forced walk break triggered by the hot opening surge. On a Catalina prep run this stop is an early warning that pacing discipline needs work.
tip.zh: 2公里处配速骤降至41分/公里，心率从162跌至134，是前段过快导致的被迫行走。准备Catalina岛赛时，主动控制配速比被迫停步要经济得多。

title.zh: 第一次停步后的恢复质量

tip.en: After the walk break you rebuilt to sub-7:00 pace within 60–80 seconds and HR climbed back steadily from 135 to 142 without spiking — that's a decent physiological reset. The problem is needing it at all this early in the run.
tip.zh: 停步后约60-80秒内你恢复到了7分/公里以内的配速，心率平稳回升未再爆表，说明有氧基础尚可。但在全程前1/5就需要重置，仍需反思开段策略。

title.en: Second Stop Cuts Into Race-Sim Continuity
title.zh: 3.5公里第二次停步破坏连续性

tip.en: Another 60-second walk at km 3.5 — pace spikes to 52 min/km and HR dives from 151 to 141. Two forced stops in the first half of a 10-km prep run signals your aerobic threshold isn't supporting your chosen pace; in a race scenario this would become a death spiral.
tip.zh: 3.5公里再次停步约60秒，心率从151降至141。两次停步均发生在全程前半段，说明目标配速已超出当前有氧阈值承受范围，建议在训练中降速5-10秒/公里并尝试保持不停步。

tip.en: The third and longest interruption: pace hits 37 min/km and HR falls from 162 to 120, the lowest since the warmup. Each stop is longer than the last, a classic sign of cumulative fatigue from too-hot pacing. Strategically, three stops in four kilometres would wreck any race plan.
tip.zh: 第三次也是最长的一次停步，配速跌至37分/公里，心率降至120，是本次跑步除热身外的最低值。三次停步间隔递增，是累积疲劳的典型信号，须在下次训练中尽早解决配速纪律问题。

title.en: HR Climbs Back Cleanly After Long Recovery
title.zh: 长时间恢复后心率顺畅回升

tip.en: After the 90-second stop and walk-out, HR re-ramps from 138 to 148 over about 400 metres without another explosion — the body is finding a sustainable zone. Pace is a steady 5:00–6:00 and HR stabilises near your historical average. This is the rhythm you needed from km 1.
tip.zh: 经过约90秒休息并缓步过渡后，心率在约400米内从138平稳回升至148，未再冲高。这段节奏（配速5-6分钟，心率148左右）正是你全程理想的运行状态，应从起跑就保持这个感觉。

tip.en: From roughly km 5 to km 7, you held HR 155–162 with no stops and pace consistently in the 5:45–6:30 band — your cleanest stretch of the run and close to your recent-history average. This shows the fitness is there; it just needs to start at km 0.
tip.zh: 5至7公里段心率保持在155-162，无停步，配速稳定在5:45-6:30，是全程最整洁的一段，接近近期训练的平均水平。这证明体能储备是足够的，关键是要把这种状态前移到起跑阶段。

tip.en: A fourth walk break appears at km 8.8: pace drops to 9–12 min/km for about 70 seconds and HR falls from 148 to 119. With under 1.2 km left, this is a mental as much as a physical signal — in a race you must have enough in reserve to push through here rather than shut down.
tip.zh: 8.8公里处再次行走约70秒，心率从148跌至119，距终点不足1.2公里。这既是体能信号也是意志力信号——备赛时应有意识地训练在距终点1公里处咬牙维持配速，而非选择放弃。
